documentation-section.purpose: Group documentation content with governed headings, callouts, matrix layouts, and section states.
useWhen: A docs page needs a reusable section boundary.
Content needs a heading, matrix, card group, callout, or evidence block.
The section appears across more than one documentation template.
doNotUseWithoutReview: The section is only a visual card.
The content should be owned by Code Block, Demo Preview Frame, Table, or another component.
A page template needs bespoke layout outside Flow boundaries.
foundations: Titles, descriptions, callouts, and empty/error copy stay explicit.
Stack, split, matrix, cards, and callout layouts stay governed.
Surface owns the boundary without nested local panels.
Callout, dark, dense, empty, error, loading, matrix, and mobile states are explicit.
Callout and status tone are explicit without creating local visual language.
Heading order is inherited from the host template.
Governs accent, status, and interactive emphasis through Flow tokens.
accessibility: Maintain heading order from the host template.
Use semantic tables/lists for structured data.
Expose callout tone and status in text.
tests: Covers default, dense, callout, matrix, empty, loading, dark, and mobile states.
Fails when migrated pages use docs-section-surface or local matrix wrappers.
Checks Table/List semantics for structured content.

canDecide: Use Documentation Section to replace repeated docs section wrappers.
mustAsk: A new Card variant is proposed only for documentation section styling.
rejectIf: FlowDocs creates local section wrapper classes for a migrated page.
Matrix content is rendered through local div grids when Table/List is appropriate.
